statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0 meeting PCI DSS and the Safeguards Rule
Group CISO accountable; retail merchant responsibility; Qualified Individual designated
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Divisions document common control inheritance annually
Sanctions documented
Service providers and affiliates: written security terms, review before use, annual compliance check; TPSP list with responsibilities
Annual common control assessment, division samples, and the QSA ROC
Six-year retention of security documentation
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
Payment pages: page owner approves every script; integrity checked; tamper detection alerting the SOC
Unique identities; no shared accounts
Role-based least privilege for card data, customer information, and consumer reports
MFA for all workforce and all CDE access; phishing-resistant for administrators
Application and system accounts owned, vaulted, rotated, and reviewed
Access disabled within 4 hours of termination
CDE access reviewed every six months; other applications quarterly
Just-in-time privileged access through PAM
Lockout after 10 attempts; 15-minute idle re-authentication
Vendor and OT integrator access only through PAM, enabled when needed
regulatory_driver: N44-45-R01 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req. 8.2.7); NIST CSF 2.0 benchmark (PR.AA-05)

statement_summary: MFA offered to all customers; required for cardholder enrollment and changes and for portal users from 2027-03-31
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour; take tampered PIN pads out of use
One severity scale; group playbooks
Log the start of each notice clock (suspicion, discovery, determination)
Payment page alerts triaged by the SOC within 1 hour
Counsel-owned multi-regulator matrix reviewed quarterly
Financial Services: FTC notice within 30 days for 500 or more consumers; block, reissue, billing error handling
Disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K within 4 business days of a materiality determination
Annual cross-division exercise and plan test
Evidence preserved; PCI Forensic Investigator when required
Four classes; Restricted includes card, Rewards Card, EBT, and consumer report data
Encryption at rest and in transit for Restricted data
Card data stays in the CDE; quarterly discovery including file shares; stray card numbers handled as incidents
Financial Services customer information on other divisions' systems follows the Financial Services standard and is inventoried
Affiliate eligibility information used for marketing only with notice and no opt-out, or a documented exception
Immutable backups, restore-tested quarterly; FDA records retrievable within 24 hours
Media sanitized or destroyed with certificates
Retention schedule; Financial Services customer information disposed within two years of last use
Annual acknowledgment of POL-05 and the division supplement
Annual security awareness training with phishing content
Role-based training before access (developers, store staff, tag publishers, credit staff)
No card numbers by email, chat, or text; group devices only for Restricted data
Approved generative AI tools only
Call-back verification for bank detail changes
